title: Scalable Exact Inference in Non-Gaussian State Space Models via Sliced-Wasserstein Transport
abstract: We develop a non-asymptotic transport framework for exact filtering in nonlinear, non-Gaussian dynamical systems. The high variance among reviewers (scores ranging from 4 to 8) indicates substantial initial epistemic disagreement near the conference acceptance threshold.

title: A Generic Prompt Compression Layer for Commercial LLM APIs
abstract: An empirical benchmark of simple lexical pruning heuristics on API tokens. Low variance and unanimous mediocre scores show low epistemic uncertainty; investing deep human review hours here yields minimal value-of-information.

title: Mechanistic Circuit Discovery in Transformer Attention Heads via Sparse Dictionary Learning
abstract: Clear consensus high-quality discovery. Prior mean is well above the acceptance threshold with near-zero epistemic variance. Optimal routing: fast-pass directly to presentation without consuming additional reviewer budget.

title: Non-Markovian Credit Assignment via Topological Path Signatures
abstract: Highly unconventional formulation that was rejected by conventional heuristic scoring due to noisy preliminary signals, but later garnered over 300 citations as a breakthrough in mathematical RL.
